name: GPU CSG Ray Tracing with Uniform Grid Index
definition: A GPU-based ray tracer for Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) that uses a uniform grid index over the root universe's cells to accelerate ray traversal, replacing the unindexed full-scan approach.
summary: This GPU CSG ray tracer accelerates traversal by replacing unindexed full-scans with a uniform grid index, eliminating wasted steps on infinite extensions and correcting CPU parity bugs.
